saves.source: The stock RGSS1 save scripts write Save<n>.rxdata beside Game.exe; mkxp-z runs a game's own scripts unchanged (binding/binding-mri.cpp:964), so a game may move them, e.g. into a Save folder (seen in a shipped RGSS3 game)
